# DESIGN:OS Studio (design-os-studio)

> Local-first Rust/wgpu interface design studio with 387/387 Figma UI3 & .fig v106 binary read/write parity, 100/100 Figma A-to-Z Micro-Interactions, native Agentic PTY Chat UI, 11-stage Spec Reader, and 22 MCP tools.

Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio (`wgpu` Metal / DirectX 12 / Vulkan + `tiny-skia`), enterprise Figma `.fig` v106 binary read/write engine, 100/100 Figma A-to-Z Micro-Interactions (`#1..#100`), native Agentic PTY Chat UI (`Claude Code` · `Codex` · `Antigravity CLI`), 11-stage `PRODUCT:OS Spec Driven v2` Reader, multi-target Dev Mode code generator, and 22-tool Model Context Protocol server (`designos-mcp`) built in 100% Rust.

## Key Facts & Verification Metrics

- **Overview & Live Visual Proof Gallery**: https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio
- **Canonical Agent Skill**: `skills/design-os-studio/SKILL.md`
- **Diagnostics**: `python3 scripts/self_check.py` and `/doctor` (`commands/doctor.md`)
- **Figma Parity & Micro-Interactions**: `387 / 387` (`100.00%`) verified parity with Figma Desktop `126.9.13` UI3 dark chrome (`#1e1e1e`) & `fig-kiwi` v106 binary schema + `100 / 100` (`#1..#100`) Figma A-to-Z Micro-Interactions + `12 / 12` Zero-Fake-UI invariants + `9 / 9` Self-Evolution ALIVE gates (`856` automated tests, `0` failures)
- **Enterprise Scale (`VSF - PCP.fig`)**: Opens and renders `723,136` Kiwi records / `112,474` scene nodes in `1.48s - 1.63s` with `0.0%` static viewport CPU usage and `-96.5%` compact disk size (`242 MB` vs `6.80 GB`)
- **Cross-Platform Installers**: macOS `.dmg` + `.tar.gz`, Windows NSIS `-setup.exe` + `.zip`, Linux `.deb` + `.tar.gz` bundling all 4 binaries (`designos-studio`, `designos`, `designos-mcp`, `designos-diff`)
- **Privacy & License**: Zero telemetry (`PRIVACY.md`), dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`)

## DESIGN:OS Ecosystem

- [DESIGN:OS Studio](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/): Native Rust/wgpu interface design studio & Figma `.fig` v106 engine.
- [DESIGN:OS CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/): Multi-runtime design CLI for Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity.
- [Knowledge Builder](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/): Multimodal knowledge compiler with UKMC.v1 contract & epistemic gate.
- [Figma Plugin & CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-figma-plugin/): Live canvas bridge for AI coding agents on Figma Free.
- [SVG Animation Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Deterministic vector animation & 1080p 60fps video pipeline.
- [3D Blender Agent](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-3d-blender/): Mechanical parts generation with embedded Three.js CAD viewer.
- [OPAH ONE](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/): 249g indoor drone showcase with scroll-scrub kinematics.
- [GitHub Pages Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/): 9-tier zero-dependency scaffolder with SEO, AEO & GEO.
- [Apple Design OS](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-apple/): Native SwiftUI 6.2 component system for iOS, iPadOS & macOS.
- [Agent Teacher](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-pedagogy/): Evidence-graded pedagogy library and curriculum tree runtime.
- [Origami CAD](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/): Parametric packaging dielines, spot-color PDFs & 3D fold previews.
- [Voice UX & AI Agent Architecture](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-voice-ux/): Full-duplex barge-in FSMs & sub-500ms voice specs.
- [Code2Flow](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-code2flow/): Local-first codebase-to-user-flow audit CLI across 7 UI frameworks.
- [Generative UI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-generative-ui/): Streaming interactive visual runtime with morphdom & WebGL.
